description: Three pairs of triangles of the final mesh pass through each other (a kernel or evaluator bug): blocker, the count against 0.

findings.fix: this is a bug in the evaluator or the kernel, not in your part: please report it with the part file and its parameters; other parameter values may avoid it meanwhile
findings.message: the mesh passes through itself: 3 pairs of triangles cross (a printable part has 0), so a slicer cannot tell inside from outside there

unchecked.reason: no printer or bed was given, so the part was not checked against a build volume; choose a printer (openbrick validate --printer, or the playground's printer menu) or give a bed (--bed WxDxH)
